methods.description: Identify random, systematic, stratified or self-selected selection from who chooses the members, grouping and list order.
Use a complete list and choose different names or numbers at random so every member has an equal chance.
Divide population size by sample size, choose a random start in the first interval, then follow the fixed step through the list.
Use each group share times the sample size, check the total, and judge whether planned group numbers match their population shares.
Choose or compare methods for the survey aim, relevant groups, access and voluntary replies; explain small-sample variation without treating a larger sample as a cure for bias.
Trace the selected positions through a repeating list, identify excluded staff, and replace the selection by random choice from the full list.
